title.en: Creating a National Preparatory Committee and Designating a Coordinating Secretariat for the Philippine Participation in Habitat: the United Nations Conference on Human Settlements in Vancouver, Canada, in 1976

text.en:
There is hereby created a Philippine National Preparatory Committee for HABITAT: The United
Nations Conference on Human Settlements whose members shall be drawn from agencies and bodies engaged
in human settlements development. To this end, the First Lady, Mrs. Imelda R. Marcos, is hereby designated
Chairman of said National Preparatory Committee, with the Director- General of the National Economic and
Development Authority, the Assistant Secretary of Foreign Affairs for United Nations and International
Conferences, the Chairman of the Task Force on Human Settlements, the Director of the Environmental
Center of the Philippines, the Chairman- General Manager of the People's Homesite and Housing Corporation
and the Officer-in-Charge of the Presidential Assistant on Housing and Resettlements Agency as members.

The Committee shall have the following powers and functions:
a. To prepare and submit to the President for approval the plans and proposals for Philippine participation in
HABITAT, including proposed country and position papers, exhibits, delegation members, and other
participation matters.
b. To call upon any department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of the government for such
assistance as it may need in the performance of its duties and functions.

To provide the technical and staff support to the National Preparatory Committee, the staff of the Task
Force on Human Settlements is hereby designated as Coordinating Secretariat of the Committee with the
Project Director of the Task force as Committee Executive Officer.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of December, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Four.
